## AccrualVault.netApy property

The MetaMorpho vault's current instantaneous Annual Percentage Yield (APY) weighted-averaged over its market deposits, after deducting the performance fee. If interested in the APY at a specific timestamp, use `getNetApy(timestamp)` instead.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get netApy(): number;
```
